 AT&T customers can earn 5K American Airlines miles just for linking accounts
 By Stephen Pepper - October 27, 2026 3 
 American Airlines has had a partnership with AT&T for a little while. Previously, that partnership has offered a good chunk of bonus miles when switching service to AT&T, but there’s now a new promotion that’s offering up to 5,000 bonus miles for existing customers, simply for linking your accounts.
 The Deal
 Link your American Airlines AAdvantage and AT&T accounts and earn up to 5,000 bonus miles:
 5,000 miles – first 65,000 members who link accounts
 2,500 miles – for all AT&T customers after the first 65,000
 Direct link to offer .
 Key Terms
 You must link your AAdvantage account to your AT&T account to receive these benefits.
 The name in your AAdvantage account must match the name in your AT&T account to receive bonus miles.
 Quick Thoughts
 This is a no-brainer if you’re an AT&T customer seeing as it should only take a minute to link your accounts. The nice thing is that even if you’re not one of the first 65,000 people to link your accounts, you’ll still earn 2,500 bonus miles.
